details: Measured 27 Oct: the front resumed the change cycle (plugins/delegate/workflows/cycle.js) with `gate_fixes: 2` at the top level of args instead of under `settings`; the script ignored the key without a word, replayed every stage from cache in 8 ms and stopped at the same red gate, so one run was wasted and the cause was found only by reading the script. Principle 10: a refusal names the next step.
failing_case: Workflow with cycle.js and args {base, relay, scratch, items, gate_fixes: 2} runs as if gate_fixes were 1, with no message.
pass_cases: An unknown top-level key stops the run in one line before any agent starts, naming the key and where it belongs (for a known setting: 'gate_fixes goes under settings').
Known keys and settings run as today.
tests/test_cycle_workflow.py covers the refusal and fails with the check disabled.
findings.summary: The cycle script ignores an unknown argument silently

details: CONFIRMED by a probe. CFG = Object.assign({}, DEFAULTS, A.settings || {}) copies any key; refusal() checks only the keys in
BOUNDS and gate_args, so a misspelt setting is dropped without a word. This is the same failure the item measured (a run
replayed with a setting that never took effect, cause found only by reading the script), one level down, and the queue
item's title is "ignores an unknown argument silently": settings are args. Principle 10 (a refusal names the next step);
principle 2 (a wasted run). The fix is in the same function the change edited. Size: 5 agent minutes.
failing_case: args {base: "master", relay: true, scratch: S, items: [{name: "u", wt: "/w", check: "c", branch: "b"}],
settings: {gate_fix: 2}} -> no refusal; the build agent starts and the run behaves as gate_fixes 1, with no message.
Should be: refused in one line naming gate_fix and the known settings (gate_turns, gate_fixes, gate_reruns, retry_dead,
fix_hint: In refusal(), after the top-level loop: for (const k of Object.keys(A.settings || {})) if (!(k in DEFAULTS)) return
`refused: unknown setting ${k} (known: ${Object.keys(DEFAULTS).join(', ')})`. Use Object.hasOwn(DEFAULTS, k) for both
checks. Add the case to the new test.
pass_cases: 1. settings {gate_fix: 2} -> result.refused names "gate_fix" and lists the known settings; labels == [].
2. settings {gate_fixes: 2} -> runs as today (no refusal, gate_fixes 2 used).
3. settings {gate_reruns: 3} -> refused "setting gate_reruns must be a whole number from 0 to 2" as today.
4. top-level gate_fixes: 2 -> refused "gate_fixes goes under settings" as in the new test.
reason: test_unknown_setting_and_unit_field_are_refused_before_any_agent passes, fails at base; cycle.js settings check.
findings.summary: an unknown key under settings (a typo such as gate_fix) is still ignored silently and the run starts

details: PLAUSIBLE as a reachable mistake, CONFIRMED by reading: the unit loop checks required fields per kind but never refuses
an unknown one, so an optional field misspelt (item, branch in project mode, review in a design) is dropped. Outside the
item's literal pass cases (top level), hence LOW; cheap to add with a field list per kind from the header comment.
evidence: cycle.js:63-81: unit checks test only wt, check, branch, fix, fixes, findings, built per kind; no Object.keys(it) check.
failing_case: relay mode, items [{name: "u", wt: "/w", check: "c", branch: "b", itme: "some-slug"}] -> no refusal; the cycle runs and,
having no it.item, never closes the queue item. Should be: refused "unit u has an unknown field itme".
fix_hint: A per-kind field list (name, kind, wt, check, branch, item, built, fix, fixes, findings) and one loop over Object.keys(it)
refusing the rest; the same for designs (name, brief, out, review).
pass_cases: 1. unit with itme -> refused naming itme; labels == [].
2. unit {name, wt, check, branch, item} (change) -> runs as today.
3. kind fix with {fix, fixes, findings} -> runs as today.
reason: Same test covers the unit-field refusal; cycle.js UNIT_KEYS check.
findings.summary: an unknown key in a unit (e.g. itme for item) is ignored silently, so a queue item is not closed
